profile.role_note: Standard-banner 5-star Fusion main DPS; swap-friendly quickswap carry whose Liberation transforms her into a melee brawler.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: She's a permanent standard-banner 5-star, so she can spook you from any limited banner or be chosen from a standard selector — never spend limited pulls chasing her. Worth building only if you like her quickswap playstyle and need a Fusion DPS.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Stringmaster (or Cosmic Ripples / Augment) + 5-piece Molten Rift in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Inferno Rider in the main slot. Crit Rate or Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Fusion DMG Bonus on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Encore has no personal signature weapon. Stringmaster (technically Yinlin's signature) is her long-standing best-in-slot: 36% Crit Rate substat, DMG bonus, and off-field ATK stacks that suit her swap-cancel style.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: The standard 5-star Rectifier (pickable from the Union Level 45 selector); high base ATK, ATK% substat, Energy Regen passive, and Basic ATK DMG stacking.

ranked_weapons.name: Augment
ranked_weapons.note: Battle Pass weapon with Crit Rate substat and an ATK% boost on Resonance Liberation release; excellent value.

ranked_weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
ranked_weapons.note: Budget pick; ATK and HP boost on Intro Skill release — nearly always active given Encore's frequent swapping.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: 2-pc gives 10% Fusion DMG; 5-pc gives 30% Fusion DMG for 15s after casting Resonance Skill. Inferno Rider also buffs Fusion and Basic ATK DMG.

echo_sets.name: Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: ATK-focused alternative (10% ATK 2-pc; stacking on-field ATK up to 20% + Outro DMG 60% at 5-pc) if Molten Rift farming goes poorly.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Fusion DMG +10% and ATK +10% mix while farming a full 5-piece set.

stat_priorities.note: Crit Rate unless you hit 70%+ from substats/weapon, then Crit DMG.
Fusion DMG Bonus on both 3-costs; ATK% as fallback.
ATK% on both; her Liberation-era damage scales directly off ATK.

build.weapon_filler_note: Encore has no personal signature weapon; Stringmaster is consistently named best-in-slot despite being Yinlin's signature.

teams.name: Classic Quickswap: Encore + Sanhua + Verina

members.name: Encore
members.note: Core quickswap carry; Liberation burst window then swap-cancel out.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Outro grants 38% Basic ATK DMG Deepen — Encore's most important damage source.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals (keeps Encore above 70% HP for her inherent DMG bonus) and buffs the whole team with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Swap-cancel Encore's Resonance Skill to build energy and Concerto while Sanhua and Verina rotate their buffs; Sanhua Outro into Encore's Liberation for the enhanced basic-attack combo, swap out after the burst, repeat.

teams.name: Dual Fusion: Changli + Encore + Verina

members.name: Changli
members.note: Fusion DMG buffer via Outro plus strong on-field presence; the classic Fusion duo.

members.name: Encore
members.note: Swapped in for her Liberation burst, powered by Changli's Fusion DMG Outro.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Universal buffer and healer; keeps both carries topped up.

teams.rotation: Verina buffs, Changli runs her on-field combo and Outros into Encore; Encore Liberation burst with Changli's Fusion DMG bonus active, then swap back to Changli.

teams.name: Free-to-Play: Encore + Sanhua + Baizhi

members.name: Encore
members.note: Main carry; cheap to gear since she only needs Fusion/ATK/Crit.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free from logins; same 38% Basic ATK Deepen Outro synergy.

members.name: Baizhi
members.note: Free 4-star healer; keeps Encore healthy for the 70% HP damage threshold.

teams.rotation: Baizhi heals and buffs, Sanhua builds Concerto and Outros, Encore takes the Liberation window; identical quickswap flow to the premium version with cheaper support.

tier_badge.label: Situational main DPS
tier_badge.note: Still a strong standard-banner Fusion carry with a fun quickswap kit, but power-crept by newer Fusion DPS.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete kit. Aim S3 for personal damage, stop at S4 for the team buff, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Complete main-DPS kit at S0; standard-banner copies come free over time.
